Vendored, unmodified from https://github.com/adobe/trustmark (js/), MIT licence (see LICENSE).
- tm_datalayer.js — watermark data layer and schema decoding
- bch_ecc.min.js — BCH error correction
Model files (decoder_Q.onnx, decoder_P.onnx, resizer.onnx) are not stored here; the app
